Olivia (Design): dropped a tiny prototype for a mini-toolbar that appears on hover/focus for vector rows. includes quick-copy, quick-download, and rerank-annotate actions. fig: https://www.figma.com/file/mini-toolbar Marco (PM): love the compact action bar. main asks: 1) make clipboard copy explicit about format (JSON vs coords) 2) quick-download should respect visible columns and current selection 3) keyboard shortcuts? Pri (Eng): tech notes: clipboard copy must be async (navigator.clipboard) and we should show ephemeral toast. for download we should stream CSV for medium sizes and use background job for >10k rows. Chen (A11y): a11y concerns: hover-only controls are inaccessible. they must be keyboard-focusable and reachable via a "row actions" menu. also the clipboard toast must be announced via aria-live. Tess (Product): microcopy: change button label from "Copy" to "Copy vector (JSON)" and download CTA to "Download selection (CSV)". make the rerank button say "Add to rerank set" not just "Rerank". design-bot: contrast check: quick-toolbar icons (#5F6AFF) on white bg pass large text only. recommend #3E4AE7 for small icons. Olivia (Design): will make controls visible on hover but also always focusable via a small affordance tab stop at row start. adding an explicit kebab menu for keyboard users. Pri (Eng): for clipboard copy snippet I'll add this pattern (will include in handoff): ``` const payload = JSON.stringify({id: row.id, vector: row.vector}); await navigator.clipboard.writeText(payload); announce('Vector copied to clipboard'); ``` Make sure the toast ties into a live region. Chen (A11y): please use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` for the toast, and when copy happens set `aria-atomic="true"`. Example: `div role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\" aria-atomic=\"true\"` Marco (PM): about quick keyboard shortcuts: what if we reserve "c" for copy and "d" for download when a row is focused? but be careful about collisions with other app shortcuts. maybe require modifier (Ctrl/Cmd). Pri (Eng): agree, use Ctrl/Cmd+C and Ctrl/Cmd+D when row has focus. we can show the shortcut in a tooltip. also debounce double-trigger to avoid accidental mass downloads. Tess (Product): export modal copy: primary CTA -> "Download selection (CSV)". helper text: "Only visible columns are included. Selected filters and ordering apply. For >10k rows we'll prepare the file in the background and email you a link." Also add a small checkbox: "Include rerank metadata (model id, score, timestamp)". design-bot: heuristic check: wording "Selected filters and ordering apply" is a bit dense. Suggest "Filters and manual ordering apply" for clarity. Olivia (Design): will update copy accordingly and add a small inline indicator in the toolbar: "Selected: 12" when multi-select present. for large sets show "10k+" shorthand. Chen (A11y): ARIA for the toolbar kebab menu example: ```
  • Copy vector (JSON)
  • Download selection (CSV)
  • Add to rerank set
``` Ensure menu traps focus and returns it to the kebab button when closed. Pri (Eng): implementation detail for downloads: add a header row with optional metadata when checkbox is checked. for client-side downloads cap at 5k rows; beyond that call the export API and show background job toast. Marco (PM): analytics: track quick-toolbar clicks and keyboard shortcut usage. also track when users opt into including rerank metadata. Tess (Product): UX ask: show an approximate file size in export modal (e.g., "~3.8MB") when we can estimate. if background export, show ETA or "We'll email you when ready." Olivia (Design): I'll update Figma with: 1) accessible kebab + focusable toolbar 2) copy changes (Copy vector (JSON), Download selection (CSV), Add to rerank set) 3) toast / live region examples 4) 10k+ mocks and background export state 5) shortcut hints in tooltip. planning to upload by EOD. Chen (A11y): follow-up checklist: 1) keyboard access to toolbar 2) aria-live toast for copy/download start+complete 3) role=menu & focus return 4) announce background export submission and job id 5) ensure screen readers hear file size/ETA if available. I'll validate after Figma update. Pri (Eng): will prepare impl notes for clipboard (async), shortcuts, client-side CSV streaming, and background export endpoints. Marco (PM): timeline: target to merge spec by Thu so eng can estimate for next sprint. thanks everyone. Olivia (Design): thanks all, will post updated Figma + handoff doc here when done :thumbsup:
